STAMP REFRESHED AFTER THE 2026-09-04 REBASE, NUMBER UNCHANGED. 19.0-marin was replayed onto origin, so every SHA changed and the stamps written hours earlier were orphaned again -- the same mechanism, and the flag working. Re-measured at b67fa612706 in a clean detached worktree, and it reads what the floor already said. The invocation is confirmed rather than assumed: lint_sql_injection is not orphaned, its floor is 9, and the same run reads 9. Scope trap worth recording, because I hit it: run from the REPO ROOT, where 'odoo/' means the core package and the lint roots are 'odoo addons'; run one level up and ruff reports 3,117 findings from the bundled addons against a hard-zero floor.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

STAMP REFRESHED, NUMBER UNCHANGED. The old stamp named a commit the 2026-09-02 sync replayed away, so `--list` flagged it ORPHANED-BASE and architecture.yml exited 2 asking to be re-measured rather than comparing anything -- neither green nor red. Re-measured in a clean detached worktree of 1ad4d29c24e and it reads exactly what the floor already said, so only the stamp moves.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

STAMPED, NOT MOVED. The floor carried no `measured_at` at all, so it was a number nobody could reproduce: the guard that refuses a stamp this branch never had cannot fire on a floor with no stamp, and an unstamped floor may never have been true of any tree. Re-measured on a clean detached worktree at the stamped commit -- python tooling/architecture/py_function_length.py --addon crm --count -- and it reads 147, equal to the floor. The count does not move; only the stamp does.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

ruff format over the 21 addons/*crm* modules, at the ruff.toml line-length of 88. 10 -> 147, and none of it is new code: py_function_length budgets a function in LINES, so wrapping a long expression into several short ones raises the excess by exactly what the wrap costs. The tree-wide sibling shows the same effect at scale and lands back on its own pre-strip value to the unit (12744 -> 12977, having been 12977 before the comments came out), which is the cleanest statement of the tension there is -- removing a comment line and re-wrapping the statement under it are equal and opposite on this metric. Measured in a detached worktree at HEAD carrying this change alone; the shared tree reads 12867 because another session has uncommitted work in addons. ruff check --fix contributed 0 to this number: it was measured separately at 10 and moved nothing.
